instruction: Organize the mountain pictures in my Pictures directory by creating a new folder named 'Famous_Mountains' and moving all three mountain images into it.

result.command: python3 -c "import os; import json; result = {'folder_exists': os.path.exists('/home/user/Pictures/Famous_Mountains'), 'files_moved': sorted([f for f in os.listdir('/home/user/Pictures/Famous_Mountains') if f.endswith('.jpg')]) if os.path.exists('/home/user/Pictures/Famous_Mountains') else [], 'original_empty': len([f for f in os.listdir('/home/user/Pictures') if f.endswith('.jpg') and 'picture' in f.lower()]) == 0}; print(json.dumps(result))"
